changes: All five active REVIEW Agent prompts now receive one canonical, English Finding-triage contract in both supported envelope modes. Owner and implementer guidance is bounded, and focused safeguards reject authority-laundering language without changing Dynamic Finding runtime semantics.
usage: Generate any active REVIEW role through proof-or-stop agent_prompt or review_run_start; the assembled prompt instructs the reviewer to classify, preserve evidence, route with an owner, and leave machine gate decisions to Proof-or-Stop.
expectedOutcome: Each active REVIEW Agent sees the same bounded triage rules, non-REVIEW roles do not receive them, and Dynamic Finding handlers, schemas, predicates, and lifecycle gates remain unchanged.
actualTranscript: Focused prompt-registry and full-context smokes passed, the live transcript records all checklist scenarios passing, independent REVIEW and delivery checks passed, and the complete configured validation suite passed.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible difference from the expected outcome; the delivered behavior matches the approved Agent-side scope.
limitations: Dynamic Finding runtime schemas, handlers, predicates, gates, and the future signed deferral mechanism remain intentionally unchanged; this Story implements Agent guidance and prompt assembly only.
pitfalls: Review repeatedly widened finite language witnesses into broader phrasing concerns. Future changes must freeze exact acceptance examples first. A validation run also passed its commands but could not persist while CLI-generated metadata was dirty; commit only that generated metadata before retrying.
